title: imap: APPEND command handler
description: Add APPEND to crates/imap/src/commands/append.rs. APPEND uploads a message to a mailbox. Algorithm: (1) require Authenticated or Selected state; (2) validate mailbox exists via ArticleNumberStore; (3) validate message size <= config.limits.max_message_bytes; (4) receive LITERAL bytes from imap-next (imap-codec handles LITERAL flow); (5) parse as RFC 2822 message using mailparse; (6) validate it would pass the NNTP POST checks (required headers: From, Subject, Date, Message-ID, Newsgroups); (7) store via the transit pipeline write path (v1: skip actual IPFS write, return tagged OK [APPENDUID uidvalidity uid] with a note that actual ingestion is done via NNTP POST/IHAVE); (8) assign next UID from imap_uid_validity, update next_uid. Defensive: message too large -> tagged NO [OVERQUOTA]; parse error -> tagged NO [CANNOT]; unknown mailbox -> tagged NO [NONEXISTENT].
